legend.SOURCE-INSPECTED: encoding or predicate read directly in indexed production source
legend.FINITE-CRYPTO-CHECK: a concrete pairing or signature equation checked for supplied bytes in a finite case
legend.UNPROVED: constraint soundness, VK-to-matrix correspondence or semantic correspondence not proved
legend.LEDGER-PREMISE: fact supplied by the Cardano ledger/TxInfo, not by Plutus code
legend.CALLER-PREMISE: value supplied by host/prover/caller and not authenticated by the inspected Rust path
legend.OPEN: no indexed evidence closes the predicate

claims.layer: validators/c2.ak spend -> claim.ak:111-149 release: release_own_token, release_single_token, release_burned (no T3 output holds c2_hash), release_claimant_signs (claimant_vkh in tx.extra_signatories), release_spent_or_expired (env.settle_outref in current tx.inputs OR Finite(lower_bound) > env.expiry)
claims.classification: SOURCE-INSPECTED; claimant signature authenticity is a LEDGER-PREMISE (ledger verifies the Ed25519 signature; Plutus sees the VKH list)
claims.mandatedDesign: Because settle_claim_input finds the claim among spent tx.inputs, T3 itself spends the C2 input, so c2.spend/release executes inside T3. Multi-asset conservation then forces c2.mint Burn with quantity -1 of the claim token in the same T3 (claim.ak:74-76 burn_only permits negative-only mint), and the Ed25519 claimant must sign T3. claim.release forbids any C2 token output in T3. There is no post-success separate T4 burn: after T3 the C2 UTxO no longer exists. A separate claim-burn transaction exists only as the alternative post-expiry refund when T3 never settles, using the after_expiry disjunct; release_spent_or_expired tests the current transaction's inputs, not chain history. Carrier lovelace of the consumed claim input becomes ordinary T3 value (see EXPERIMENT-OBLIGATIONS O-FIN-3R).

claims.claim: Rust statement encoding and context binding (current 30-file packet, 325255 B, HEAD 752c7aa7a07523a7bc5bf929fcadc094815c48e4; selected snapshot, not whole embedded compiler identity)
claims.classification: SOURCE-INSPECTED encoding: 343-byte header (tag 0/16, family 16/32, predicate 48/32, shape 80/32, 227 context bytes 112-338, body_len 339/4) plus program-dependent body in planned order (inputs; pre values/cells/duties; post values/cells/duties; ordered effects; per-debit-cell gross then fees); BLAKE2b-256 of the full statement split into two big-endian 128-bit halves as public inputs. abi2 bind_v2 treats tag/family/predicate/shape/body-length as constants and the context segment as free witness bytes that are hashed; body length and order derive from the selected program/action, so there is no fixed universal 378-byte body and changing source asset identities can change program, shape and descriptor.
claims.notEnforced: Caller-supplied ContextInput is not ledger authentication: context_from_input(claim.rs) accepts claimantVkh, settleHash, threadId, consumedTxid/Ix, seq, catalogueDigest, intentsDigest and vkDigest from the caller. networkId is a u8 ABI byte at offset 172; it is NOT a conversion of Preprod magic 1 and no such conversion exists in the inspected path. Admission is exactly Core1 / SettlementHashV2 / NotBound / GrossDebitAndFees / TouchedOnly (relation.rs); frontend admit_source refuses /2 with StagedNotLowered; there is no invoice filename allowlist. compile_selected(source, selector) does not take context, so a context change might preserve the descriptor, but native proving-key reuse for a fresh context is UNPERFORMED: descriptor fields and source pins must be compared (require_same) before any future private-custody operator proving-key read under fresh exact scope. Constraint soundness, hash-gadget correctness and the VK-to-matrix link remain UNPROVED. The packet omits 8 compiler members and 64 Core/driver dependencies (lowering, gadgets, R1CS and hash primitives, Core parser/stage/policy/lexer closure, driver setup/inspect/error modules, registry crate bodies): no full circuit theorem is claimed. No maintainer public compile/prove/deploy admission exists in the inspected source.

summaryAnswer: claim.issue alone accepts any prover-selected 488 B VK and 192 B proof verifying the envelope's own statement digest. Authorised-relation binding exists only at settle consumption: S2p c2_hash parameter, genesis-pinned catalogue predicate/vk/shape equality, S2p-recomputed statement digest, VI-recomputed intents digest, and - inside the same T3 - C2 release with Burn -1 and the Ed25519 claimant signature. The Rust statement is a 343-byte constant-header plus program-dependent body whose context segment is hashed free witness bytes over caller-supplied, unauthenticated context; constraint soundness and the VK-to-matrix link are unproved, 8 compiler and 64 Core/driver dependencies are missing, and no protocol-wide compile/prove/deploy admission exists. All 20 UTxO families, ACTUS 277/18/32 DS01-DS07, DeFi 72 DA01-DA24, general obligations, real recursion, private handoff, bounded multi-parent PCD, universal certificates and real Preprod acceptance remain open; no compatibility percentage is stated.
